name: wpilog-analyzer
description: AI-powered FRC robot log analysis via MCP. Analyzes .wpilog telemetry from the roboRIO.

commands.title: Set The Blue Alliance API Key
Clear The Blue Alliance API Key
Add to Claude Code in This Folder

wpilog-mcp.javaPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `java` executable. Leave blank to auto-detect the WPILib JDK.

wpilog-mcp.wpiLibYear.markdownDescription: WPILib installation year (e.g., `2026`). Leave blank to auto-detect the latest installed year.

wpilog-mcp.logDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the directory containing `.wpilog` files. Leave blank to auto-detect. Set it in your User settings for every project; a project's own (Workspace) setting overrides it there. A path starting with `~/` is in your home folder, on macOS, Linux, and Windows alike (`~/riologs`); write paths with forward slashes, which work on every system. A relative path is a folder inside the project.

wpilog-mcp.additionalLogDirectories.markdownDescription: More directories of `.wpilog` files, listed and searched along with **Log Directory** (for example an archive drive, or logs another team published). As there, `~/` is your home folder on every system, and forward slashes work everywhere. A relative path is a folder inside the project (for example, if your robot code writes simulation logs to a `logs` folder, `logs` lists them). A project's own (Workspace) list replaces your User list there. REV logs are matched to a wpilog only within the directory that holds it.

wpilog-mcp.teamNumber.markdownDescription: Your FRC team number, for The Blue Alliance match data when a log does not record one. Empty until you set it. A project's own (Workspace) setting overrides your User setting there.

wpilog-mcp.tbaApiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated: settings are stored in plaintext. Use the **WPILog Analyzer: Set The Blue Alliance API Key** command, which keeps the key in VS Code's secret storage. A key entered here is moved there and cleared from settings.
wpilog-mcp.tbaApiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Stored in plaintext. Use the **WPILog Analyzer: Set The Blue Alliance API Key** command instead; a key entered here is moved into VS Code's secret storage and cleared.

wpilog-mcp.enableForClaudeCode.markdownDescription: **Claude Code only** (Copilot and other VS Code agents always have the server). Make WPILog Analyzer available to Claude Code, which finds servers in a project's `.mcp.json` rather than in VS Code: the extension adds a `wpilog-analyzer` entry to the `.mcp.json` of each WPILib robot project you open, and keeps any existing entry up to date. For a folder that is not a robot project, run **WPILog Analyzer: Add to Claude Code in This Folder**. The entry holds this computer's paths, so it is never written into a `.mcp.json` that git tracks, and the extension offers to add `.mcp.json` to `.gitignore`. The TBA API key is never written into it.
